title: socket.io-redis is deprecated
summary: npm marks socket.io-redis as deprecated: "This package has been renamed to '@socket.io/redis-adapter', please see the migration guide here: https://socket.io/docs/v4/redis-adapter/#migrating-from-socketio-redis"

constraints: Preserve adapter behavior: pub/sub and request/response channels, key prefixes, and multi-node session routing.

steps.title: Replace the adapter package
steps.instructions: Replace socket.io-redis with @socket.io/redis-adapter and follow the published migration guide for the adapter options.

steps.title: Verify multi-node behavior
steps.instructions: Connect clients through more than one server instance and confirm broadcasts, rooms, and acknowledgements still work.

verification.purpose: Run the realtime and repository tests when defined.
